step.cmd: Fact-find with the client to resolve the entitlement issue:
In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Details: Document the fact-finding details according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: Determine if the client was reached during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the client was reached, go to step 8.
If the client was not reached or did not reply to the N-10-00-00 letter and a change to the type of parental benefits is required to correct the claim, go to step 13.
If the client was not reached or did not reply to the N-10-00-00 letter, go to Unable to contact the client . Unable to contact the client
